assumptions.statement_zh: 使用仓库提供的provisional边界进行空间生成，官方精确边界多边形尚未发布
assumptions.statement_en: Using repository-provided provisional boundary; official precise boundary polygon not yet released
assumptions.impact: All area metrics are low-confidence design-model values; official data release triggers recalculation

assumptions.statement_zh: 官方控规条件（容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度等）尚未公开
assumptions.statement_en: Official regulatory conditions (FAR, building height, density, etc.) not yet public
assumptions.impact: Development intensity metrics marked as unknown; only conceptual spatial organization provided

assumptions.statement_zh: 现状建筑普查和权属调查数据尚未获取
assumptions.statement_en: Existing building survey and ownership investigation data not yet obtained
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish classification is directional only; specific list requires professional survey

assumptions.statement_zh: 京张铁路沿线文物保护单位清单和保护范围需以文物部门评估为准
assumptions.statement_en: Cultural relic protection unit list and protection scopes along Jing-Zhang Railway subject to cultural relics department assessment
assumptions.impact: Heritage protection measures are conceptual; specific protection requires professional evaluation

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨道交通线网规划和站点规划以官方规划为准
assumptions.statement_en: Rail transit network and station planning subject to official planning
assumptions.impact: TOD development concepts are directional; specific station integration requires official confirmation

assumptions.statement_zh: 低空经济试飞需民航和空管部门审批
assumptions.statement_en: Low-altitude economy flight testing requires civil aviation and air traffic control approval
assumptions.impact: Low-altitude scenarios are conceptual suggestions; implementation requires regulatory approval

assumptions.statement_zh: 市政基础设施容量数据（电力、供水、排水等）尚未获取
assumptions.statement_en: Municipal infrastructure capacity data (power, water, drainage, etc.) not yet obtained
assumptions.impact: New infrastructure layout is conceptual; capacity verification requires municipal design team

assumptions.statement_zh: AI产业发展预测和企业入驻计划存在不确定性
assumptions.statement_en: AI industry development forecasts and enterprise settlement plans have uncertainty
assumptions.impact: Industry cluster layout is strategic direction; actual development depends on market and policy

assumptions.statement_zh: 风水与中华文脉理念作为文化叙事和空间组织智慧的现代转译，非封建迷信
assumptions.statement_en: Fengshui and Chinese cultural lineage concepts are modern translations of cultural narrative and spatial organization wisdom, not feudal superstition
assumptions.impact: Used as design inspiration and cultural expression, not as technical planning basis

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有AI场景设计遵循隐私保护和人工复核原则
assumptions.statement_en: All AI scenario designs follow privacy protection and human review principles
assumptions.impact: Scenario implementation requires compliance with data protection laws and ethical review
